eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input; window.__scope = (on) => { if (on !== w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; p.pitch = 0; __scope(true); const cam = g.engine.camera; cam.updateMatrixWorld(); const k = 9.8 / (2 * 500 * 500); const f = new cam.position.constructor(); cam.getWorldDirection(f); const marks = [...document.querySelectorAll('.hud-scope [data-bdc] rect')].map((r, i) => { const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = [200, 300, 400][i]; const pt = cam.position.clone().addScaledVector(f, d); pt.y -= Math.tan(k * (d - 100)) * d; pt.project(cam); const esperado = ((1 - pt.y) / 2) * innerHeight - innerHeight / 2; return { d, tracinhoPx: +(b.top + b.height / 2 - innerHeight / 2).toFixed(2), esperadoPx: +esperado.toFixed(2) }; }); return { naLuneta: w.inScope, fov: cam.fov, rotulos: [...document.querySelectorAll('.hud-scope [data-bdc] text')].map((t) => t.textContent), marcas: marks }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, B = g.ballistics, cam = g.engine.camera; const o = cam.position.clone(); const f = new o.constructor(); cam.getWorldDirection(f); f.y = 0; f.normalize(); const k = 9.8 / (2 * 500 * 500); const res = []; for (const d of [100, 200, 300, 395]) { B.fire(o, f); const b = B.bullets.find((x) => x.active && x.after < 0 && x.dist === 0); let hit = null; for (let i = 0; i < 400 && hit === null && b.active && b.after < 0; i++) { B.update(1 / 60, (pos, dir, step) => { if (hit !== null) return false; const a = Math.hypot(pos.x - o.x, pos.z - o.z); const e = Math.hypot(pos.x + dir.x * step - o.x, pos.z + dir.z * step - o.z); if (a <= d && e >= d) hit = pos.y + dir.y * step * ((d - a) / (e - a)); return false; }); } b.active = false; const alvo = o.y - Math.tan(k * (d - 100)) * d; res.push({ d, quedaAbaixoDaMiraCm: +((o.y - hit) * 100).toFixed(1), erroNoAlvoCm: +((hit - alvo) * 100).toFixed(1) }); } return res; })()
